note: Code snippets for Edit > Insert Snippet. Every body here is syntax this build runs: each construct appears in a program under Examples/ or in docs/LANGUAGE_GUIDE.md. $CURSOR$ marks where the caret lands after insertion; $SELECTION$ is replaced by the selected text.

basic.name: Hello world
basic.description: The smallest program: print a line, then end.

basic.name: FOR loop
basic.description: Count from 1 to 10, one line each.
basic.body:
10 FOR I = 1 TO 10
20   PRINT I
30 NEXT I
$CURSOR$

basic.name: Ask for input
basic.description: Read a string into a variable and echo it.

pilot.name: Question with a match
pilot.description: Ask, read an answer, and continue only when it matches.
pilot.body:

logo.name: Square procedure
logo.description: A procedure that draws a square of any size.
logo.body:
TO SQUARE :SIDE
  REPEAT 4 [ FORWARD :SIDE RIGHT 90 ]
END
$CURSOR$

logo.name: Spiral
logo.description: Thirty-six turns of a little more than a right angle.

logo.name: Print a word
logo.description: Print a word, using Logo's bracketed word syntax.

comal.name: FOR loop
comal.description: Count from 1 to 5 with an explicit NEXT.
comal.body:
10 FOR I := 1 TO 5
20   PRINT I
30 NEXT I
$CURSOR$

comal.name: Procedure
comal.description: A named procedure with one parameter.

rexx.name: DO loop
rexx.body:
DO i = 1 TO 5
  SAY i
END
$CURSOR$

rexx.name: SELECT
rexx.description: A multi-way branch with WHEN and OTHERWISE.
rexx.body:
SELECT
  WHEN score >= 90 THEN SAY 'Grade A'
  OTHERWISE SAY 'Needs work'
END
$CURSOR$

chip8.name: Draw a digit
chip8.description: Clear the screen and draw the font glyph for 2.
chip8.body:
start:  CLS
        LD   V0, 0x04
        LD   V1, 0x06
        LD   F, V0
        DRW  V0, V1, 5
